name: EUMAKERS
summary: Italian PLA filament brand from Barletta, Puglia, founded in 2014 by Demi Sfregola as the 3D branch of the family's Rigenera Biocompound and SMP plastic-extrusion businesses. It sells NatureWorks Ingeo-based PLA in matte, silk, metallic, pearl, iridescent, fluorescent, glitter and UV-glow finishes, with a spool re-use programme.

oem_relationships.notes: Per 3DPrint.com, EUMAKERS belongs to the SMP plastic-extrusion group, founded by founder Demi Sfregola's grandfather.

EUMAKERS is described as Rigenera's '3D branch' (3DPrint.com, Cults3D profile); a supplier listing names 'RIGENERA DI SFREGOLA COSIMO DAMIANO'. The exact corporate structure between Rigenera and SMP is unverified.

additional_notes: Address Via degli Artigiani 74, Barletta, per a packaging-design listing. NatureWorks supplies the raw PLA resin; that is a raw-material supply relationship, not an OEM relationship. No catalog OEM link. EUMAKEIT is a related line of upcycled design objects. One Ultimaker-forum user noted an intentionally rough filament surface that makes Bowden feeding harder (anecdotal). The eumakers.com domain was not fetched, so no endpoints are recorded. Has a Cults3D 'EUMAKERS' profile. SpoolmanDB PR #358 lists 9 PLA filaments.

provenance.conflicts: The exact legal entity is unresolved (Rigenera sole proprietorship vs SMP group). The Barletta address comes from a third-party packaging listing.
